'''Tracey's Venomoth''' (Japanese: '''ケンジのモルフォン''' ''Kenji's Morphon'') was one of the two {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Tracey Sketchit]] before he met {{Ash}} in the [[Orange Islands]], and the first seen in his possession.

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|OS}}====
[[File:Tracey and Venomoth.png|thumb|left|250px|Venomoth and Tracey]]
{{p|Venomoth}} first debuted as a {{p|Venonat}} in ''[[EP084|The Lost Lapras]]'', where it was used to help track down {{TRT}}'s truck after they stole {{AP|an infant Lapras|Lapras}} from a [[Pokémon Center]]. Using its special ability known as "radar eye", it was able to locate Team Rocket, and {{Ash}} was able to rescue Lapras.

In ''[[EP087|The Crystal Onix]]'', Tracey attempted to use Venonat to find an [[Crystal Onix|Onix made out of crystal]]. It was shown a glass sculpture of it that {{OBP|Mateo|EP087}}'s grandfather made and ask to look for something similar. However it only found a pile of rocks, but it was still convinced that it found what Tracey wanted.

In ''[[EP097|Tracey Gets Bugged]]'', Venonat was teamed up with {{TP|Tracey|Marill}} to find some {{type|Bug}} Pokémon to watch on [[Murcott Island]]. Aside from {{p|Caterpie}} and {{p|Pinsir}}, they were able to find an [[Tracey's Scyther|injured and elderly Scyther]]. Tracey asked Venonat to assist in trying to help Scyther, but it was initially intimidated by it. But its {{pkmn|Trainer}} told it to stay strong, and it used Sleep Powder on the {{pkmn|category|Mantis Pokémon}}, which Tracey then captured.

In ''[[EP106|The Pokémon Water War]]'', while on [[Ascorbia Island]], Tracey used Venonat's radar eye to help find [[Captain Aidan]]'s [[Team Wartortle|Wartortle]] and [[Ash's Squirtle]] and {{AP|Pikachu}} who were taken by Team Rocket. It located them and assisted by attacking them with {{m|Tackle}}.

In ''[[EP116|The Rivalry Revival]]'', Venonat was seen with Tracey and its teammates as they saw Ash, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} off as they departed for [[Johto]].

[[File:Venonat Radar Eye.png|thumb|220px|Venonat using its "radar eye"]]

===={{aniseries|GS}}====
Since Tracey's stay in [[Pallet Town]], Venonat appeared in ''[[EP225|Bulbasaur... The Ambassador!]]'', where it helped break up a fight between the Water and Grass Pokémon.

===={{aniseries|JN}}====
In ''[[JN147|The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!]]'', Venonat was shown to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into Venomoth. It, Tracey, and the rest of his Pokémon greeted Ash upon his visit back to Pallet Town.

===Personality and characteristics===
Venomoth has been shown to become excited if it thinks it has spotted what Tracey is looking for and responds by jumping up and down.  

Venomoth helps Tracey as a [[Pokémon Watcher]] by using its eyes to scan the area and locate the Pokémon that Tracey is looking for. It can also use {{m|Sleep Powder}} to make it less likely for the Pokémon to run away. Tracey tends to use it more for Pokémon watching as opposed to battling, for which he favors {{TP|Tracey|Marill}} and {{TP|Tracey|Scyther}} more.
